autoReloadEnabled.title: Auto-reload open PDFs on disk change
autoReloadEnabled.description: When enabled, any open PDF viewer is automatically reloaded whenever its file changes on disk, regardless of what triggered the change (this command, an MCP/coding agent, a terminal, etc.).

autoReloadIntervalMs.title: Auto-reload poll interval (ms)
autoReloadIntervalMs.description: How often to check open PDFs for on-disk changes, in milliseconds.
